This report runs directly from the repository. It reads the released formatted
data from `data/` and the released posterior chains from `output/`. It does not
save figures or tables to separate folders. Each plot is generated directly in
the knitted report.

```{r setup}

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  message = TRUE,
  warning = FALSE,
  fig.align = "center",
  out.width = "100%",
  dpi = 160
)

report_input <- knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE)

if (length(report_input) == 1L &&
    !is.na(report_input) &&
    nzchar(report_input)) {
  code_dir <- dirname(normalizePath(report_input, mustWork = TRUE))
} else if (file.exists("main_inference_v1.r") && dir.exists("../data")) {

} else if (dir.exists("code") && dir.exists("data")) {

} else {

}

  dir.exists(file.path(repository_root, "data", "formatted")),
```

```{r helper-functions, echo=FALSE}
####### defining the reconstruction functions #######
read_numeric_csv <- function(path) {
  scan(path, what = numeric(), quiet = TRUE, sep = ",")
}

posterior_summary <- function(directory, parameter, tail_n = NULL) {
  path <- file.path(directory, paste0(parameter, "_mc.csv"))
  x <- read_numeric_csv(path)
  if (!is.null(tail_n) && length(x) > tail_n) x <- tail(x, tail_n)
  q <- unname(quantile(x, c(0.025, 0.5, 0.975), na.rm = TRUE))
  data.frame(parameter = parameter, lower = q[1], median = q[2], upper = q[3])
}

posterior_median <- function(directory, parameter, tail_n = NULL) {
  posterior_summary(directory, parameter, tail_n)$median
}

haversine_matrix <- function(recipient_coords, donor_coords) {
  to_rad <- pi / 180
  lon1 <- recipient_coords[, 1] * to_rad
  lat1 <- recipient_coords[, 2] * to_rad
  lon2 <- donor_coords[, 1] * to_rad
  lat2 <- donor_coords[, 2] * to_rad
  dlon <- outer(lon1, lon2, "-")
  dlat <- outer(lat1, lat2, "-")
  a <- sin(dlat / 2)^2 + outer(cos(lat1), cos(lat2)) * sin(dlon / 2)^2
  a[a < 0] <- 0
  a[a > 1] <- 1
  6371.0088 * 2 * atan2(sqrt(a), sqrt(1 - a))
}

read_era <- function(repository_root, era, n_rows = NULL) {
  directory <- file.path(repository_root, "data", "formatted", era)
  read_one <- function(name) {
    x <- read.csv(file.path(directory, name), check.names = FALSE)
    if (!is.null(n_rows)) x <- x[seq_len(min(n_rows, nrow(x))), , drop = FALSE]
    x
  }
  cases <- read_one("inferred_cases_urban.csv")
  population <- read_one("inferred_pop_urban.csv")
  susceptibles <- read_one("susceptibles_urban.csv")
  coordinates <- read.csv(
    file.path(directory, "coordinates_urban.csv"), check.names = FALSE
  )

  drop <- intersect(c("Yeovil.RD", "City.of.London"), names(cases))
  keep <- !names(cases) %in% drop
  cases <- cases[, keep, drop = FALSE]
  population <- population[, keep, drop = FALSE]
  susceptibles <- susceptibles[, keep, drop = FALSE]
  coordinates <- coordinates[, keep, drop = FALSE]

  list(
    time = cases[[1]],
    cases = as.matrix(cases[, -1, drop = FALSE]),
    population = as.matrix(population[, -1, drop = FALSE]),
    susceptibles = as.matrix(susceptibles[, -1, drop = FALSE]),
    coordinates = t(as.matrix(coordinates[, -1, drop = FALSE])),
    names = names(cases)[-1]
  )
}

read_small_cities <- function(repository_root, era) {
  path <- file.path(
    repository_root, "output", "mcmc inference", era, "small_cities.csv"
  )
  as.character(read.csv(path, check.names = FALSE)[[1]])
}

observed_event_summaries <- function(case_matrix) {
  n <- ncol(case_matrix)
  out <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = n, ncol = 6)
  colnames(out) <- c(
    "cycle_mean", "cycle_sd", "reintroductions", "zeros",
    "duration_mean", "duration_sd"
  )
  for (j in seq_len(n)) {
    x <- case_matrix[, j]
    starts <- which(x[-length(x)] == 0 & x[-1] > 0)
    ends <- which(x[-length(x)] > 0 & x[-1] == 0)
    if (length(starts) && length(ends) && ends[1] < starts[1]) ends <- ends[-1]
    k <- min(length(starts), length(ends))
    durations <- if (k) ends[seq_len(k)] - starts[seq_len(k)] + 1 else numeric()
    cycles <- diff(starts)
    out[j, ] <- c(
      if (length(cycles)) mean(cycles) else NA,
      if (length(cycles) > 1) sd(cycles) else NA,
      length(starts), sum(x == 0),
      if (length(durations)) mean(durations) else NA,
      if (length(durations) > 1) sd(durations) else NA
    )
  }
  as.data.frame(out)
}

simulate_absence_presence <- function(rate, average_population, a, b, psi,
                                      first_zero, n_sim = 20L,
                                      seed = 20201186L) {
  set.seed(seed)
  n_city <- nrow(rate)
  n_time <- ncol(rate)
  result <- array(
    NA_real_, dim = c(n_sim, n_city, 6L),
    dimnames = list(
      NULL, NULL,
      c("cycle_mean", "cycle_sd", "reintroductions", "zeros",
        "duration_mean", "duration_sd")
    )
  )
  nb_mu <- a * exp(b * log(average_population))
  nb_size <- psi / log(average_population)

  for (s in seq_len(n_sim)) {
    immune_until <- first_zero - 1L
    starts <- vector("list", n_city)
    durations <- vector("list", n_city)
    occupied <- matrix(FALSE, nrow = n_city, ncol = n_time)

    for (tt in seq_len(n_time)) {
      eligible <- tt >= first_zero & tt > immune_until
      if (!any(eligible)) next
      p <- -expm1(-pmax(rate[eligible, tt], 0))
      hit_local <- runif(sum(eligible)) < p
      if (!any(hit_local)) next
      hit <- which(eligible)[hit_local]
      duration <- 2L + rnbinom(length(hit), mu = nb_mu[hit], size = nb_size[hit])
      duration[!is.finite(duration)] <- 2L
      for (ii in seq_along(hit)) {
        city <- hit[ii]
        dur <- as.integer(duration[ii])
        starts[[city]] <- c(starts[[city]], tt)
        durations[[city]] <- c(durations[[city]], dur)
        last <- min(n_time, tt + dur - 1L)
        if (last >= tt + 1L) occupied[city, (tt + 1L):last] <- TRUE
        immune_until[city] <- tt + dur - 1L
      }
    }

    for (j in seq_len(n_city)) {
      cycles <- diff(starts[[j]])
      duration <- durations[[j]]
      result[s, j, ] <- c(
        if (length(cycles)) mean(cycles) else NA,
        if (length(cycles) > 1L) sd(cycles) else NA,
        length(starts[[j]]), n_time - sum(occupied[j, ]),
        if (length(duration)) mean(duration) else NA,
        if (length(duration) > 1L) sd(duration) else NA
      )
    }
  }
  result
}

bin_predictive_summaries <- function(simulated, observed, average_population,
                                     upper = 90000, n_bin = 40L) {
  breaks <- seq(0, upper, length.out = n_bin + 1L)
  metrics <- dimnames(simulated)[[3]]
  rows <- vector("list", length(metrics) * n_bin)
  z <- 1L
  for (metric in metrics) {
    for (i in seq_len(n_bin)) {
      members <- which(
        average_population > breaks[i] &
        average_population <= breaks[i + 1L]
      )
      values <- as.vector(simulated[, members, metric, drop = FALSE])
      q <- if (length(values)) {
        quantile(values, c(0.025, 0.5, 0.975), na.rm = TRUE)
      } else rep(NA, 3)
      obs <- if (length(members)) {
        median(observed[members, metric], na.rm = TRUE)
      } else NA
      rows[[z]] <- data.frame(
        metric = metric,
        bin = i,
        population_upper = breaks[i + 1L],
        lower = q[1],
        median = q[2],
        upper = q[3],
        observed = obs
      )
      z <- z + 1L
    }
  }
  do.call(rbind, rows)
}

source_attribution <- function(era, recipients, row_index, parameters, tau) {
  recipient_index <- match(recipients, era$names)
  stopifnot(!anyNA(recipient_index))
  donor_names <- era$names
  recipient_coords <- era$coordinates[recipient_index, , drop = FALSE]
  distance <- haversine_matrix(recipient_coords, era$coordinates)
  distance[distance < 1e-8] <- Inf
  cases <- era$cases[row_index, , drop = FALSE]
  population <- era$population[row_index, recipient_index, drop = FALSE]

  city_rows <- vector("list", length(recipients))
  event_rows <- list()
  event_z <- 1L
  for (r in seq_along(recipients)) {
    recipient_cases <- cases[, recipient_index[r]]
    events <- if (length(recipient_cases) > 1L) {
      which(
        recipient_cases[-length(recipient_cases)] == 0 &
        recipient_cases[-1] > 0
      )
    } else integer()
    if (!length(events)) {
      city_rows[[r]] <- data.frame(
        city = recipients[r], n_events = 0,
        background = NA, gravity = NA,
        dominant_source = NA, dominant_share = NA,
        dominant_distance_km = NA
      )
      next
    }
    donor_incidence <- cases[events, , drop = FALSE]^parameters$alpha_1
    base <- parameters$beta * distance[r, ]^(-parameters$rho)
    gravity <- sweep(donor_incidence, 2, base, "*")
    gravity <- gravity * population[events, r]^parameters$alpha_2
    total <- tau + rowSums(gravity)
    good <- is.finite(total) & total > 0
    gravity <- gravity[good, , drop = FALSE]
    total <- total[good]
    background <- tau / total
    source_share <- colMeans(gravity / total)
    best <- which.max(source_share)
    city_rows[[r]] <- data.frame(
      city = recipients[r],
      n_events = length(total),
      background = mean(background),
      gravity = mean(1 - background),
      dominant_source = donor_names[best],
      dominant_share = source_share[best],
      dominant_distance_km = distance[r, best]
    )
    event_rows[[event_z]] <- data.frame(
      city = recipients[r],
      time_index = row_index[events[good]],
      background = background,
      gravity = 1 - background
    )
    event_z <- event_z + 1L
  }
  list(
    city = do.call(rbind, city_rows),
    event = if (length(event_rows)) do.call(rbind, event_rows) else data.frame(),
    coordinates = recipient_coords,
    donor_names = donor_names
  )
}

local_moran_classes <- function(values, coords, k = 8L,
                                permutations = 499L, seed = 1186L) {
  set.seed(seed)
  good <- is.finite(values)
  out <- rep("not significant", length(values))
  if (sum(good) <= k + 2L) return(out)
  z <- as.numeric(scale(values[good]))
  d <- haversine_matrix(
    coords[good, , drop = FALSE], coords[good, , drop = FALSE]
  )
  diag(d) <- Inf
  neighbours <- t(apply(d, 1, order))[
    seq_len(sum(good)), seq_len(k), drop = FALSE
  ]
  observed <- vapply(seq_along(z), function(i) {
    z[i] * mean(z[neighbours[i, ]])
  }, numeric(1))
  p <- numeric(length(z))
  for (i in seq_along(z)) {
    perm <- replicate(
      permutations,
      z[i] * mean(sample(z[-i], k, replace = FALSE))
    )
    p[i] <- (1 + sum(abs(perm) >= abs(observed[i]))) / (permutations + 1)
  }
  local_mean <- vapply(seq_along(z), function(i) {
    mean(z[neighbours[i, ]])
  }, numeric(1))
  classes <- ifelse(
    p <= 0.05 & z > 0 & local_mean > 0,
    "unidentifiable hotspot",
    ifelse(
      p <= 0.05 & z < 0 & local_mean < 0,
      "gravity hotspot",
      "not significant"
    )
  )
  out[good] <- classes
  out
}

pairwise_synchrony <- function(case_matrix, coords, max_distance = 320) {
  correlation <- suppressWarnings(
    cor(case_matrix, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
  )
  distance <- haversine_matrix(coords, coords)
  upper <- upper.tri(distance)
  d <- distance[upper]
  y <- correlation[upper]
  good <- is.finite(d) & is.finite(y) & d <= max_distance
  d <- d[good]
  y <- y[good]
  grid <- seq(0, max_distance, by = 5)
  fit <- try(smooth.spline(d, y, spar = 0.65), silent = TRUE)
  prediction <- if (inherits(fit, "try-error")) {
    approx(d[order(d)], y[order(d)], xout = grid, rule = 2)$y
  } else predict(fit, grid)$y
  data.frame(
    distance_km = grid,
    synchrony = pmax(-0.05, pmin(1, prediction))
  )
}

make_land_outline <- function(coords, ratio = 0.12) {
  if (requireNamespace("sf", quietly = TRUE) &&
      "st_concave_hull" %in% getNamespaceExports("sf")) {
    geometry <- sf::st_sfc(sf::st_multipoint(coords), crs = 4326)
    outline <- sf::st_concave_hull(
      geometry, ratio = ratio, allow_holes = FALSE
    )
    xy <- sf::st_coordinates(outline)
    return(xy[, c("X", "Y"), drop = FALSE])
  }
  hull <- chull(coords[, 1], coords[, 2])
  coords[c(hull, hull[1]), , drop = FALSE]
}

panel_label <- function(label, x = 0.01, y = 0.99) {
  usr <- par("usr")
  text(
    usr[1] + x * diff(usr[1:2]),
    usr[3] + y * diff(usr[3:4]),
    label,
    font = 2,
    adj = c(0, 1),
    xpd = NA
  )
}
```

```{r load-inputs}
####### loading the released data and posterior chains #######
pre <- read_era(repository_root, "prevac", n_rows = 534L)
vac <- read_era(repository_root, "vac")

pre_mcmc <- file.path(
  repository_root, "output", "mcmc inference", "pre_vac"
)
vac_mcmc <- file.path(
  repository_root, "output", "mcmc inference", "vac"
)

pre_small <- read_small_cities(repository_root, "pre_vac")
vac_small <- read_small_cities(repository_root, "vac")

pre_parameters <- list(
  beta = posterior_median(pre_mcmc, "beta_coupling", 50000L),
  alpha_1 = posterior_median(pre_mcmc, "alpha_1", 50000L),
  alpha_2 = posterior_median(pre_mcmc, "alpha_2", 50000L),
  rho = posterior_median(pre_mcmc, "rho", 50000L),
  eta = posterior_median(pre_mcmc, "eta", 50000L),
  tau = posterior_median(pre_mcmc, "tau", 50000L),
  a = posterior_median(pre_mcmc, "a", 50000L),
  b = posterior_median(pre_mcmc, "b", 50000L),
  psi = posterior_median(pre_mcmc, "psi", 50000L)
)

vac_parameters <- list(
  beta = posterior_median(vac_mcmc, "beta_coupling"),
  alpha_1 = posterior_median(vac_mcmc, "alpha_1"),
  alpha_2 = posterior_median(vac_mcmc, "alpha_2"),
  rho = posterior_median(vac_mcmc, "rho"),
  eta = posterior_median(vac_mcmc, "eta")
)

simulation_settings <- data.frame(
  workflow = c("authors' released script", "this abridged report"),
  forward_simulations = c(100, params$simulations)
)
knitr::kable(simulation_settings)
```

# Figure 2: posterior-predictive reconstruction

```{r calculate-figure-2}
####### calculating the figure 2 predictive summaries #######
pre_recipient_index <- match(pre_small, pre$names)
pre_distance <- haversine_matrix(
  pre$coordinates[pre_recipient_index, , drop = FALSE],
  pre$coordinates
)
pre_distance[pre_distance < 1e-8] <- Inf

spatial_kernel <- pre_distance^(-pre_parameters$rho)
donor_signal <- t(pre$cases^pre_parameters$alpha_1)
gravity_force <- spatial_kernel %*% donor_signal
n_term <- t(
  pre$population[, pre_recipient_index, drop = FALSE]^pre_parameters$alpha_2
)
s_term <- t(
  pre$susceptibles[, pre_recipient_index, drop = FALSE]^pre_parameters$eta
)
rate <- s_term * (
  pre_parameters$tau + pre_parameters$beta * n_term * gravity_force
)

first_zero <- apply(
  pre$cases[, pre_recipient_index, drop = FALSE],
  2,
  function(x) which(x == 0)[1]
)
first_zero[!is.finite(first_zero)] <- nrow(pre$cases) + 1L

average_population <- colMeans(
  pre$population[, pre_recipient_index, drop = FALSE]
)

simulated <- simulate_absence_presence(
  rate,
  average_population,
  pre_parameters$a,
  pre_parameters$b,
  pre_parameters$psi,
  first_zero,
  n_sim = params$simulations,
  seed = params$seed
)

observed <- observed_event_summaries(
  pre$cases[, pre_recipient_index, drop = FALSE]
)

predictive <- bin_predictive_summaries(
  simulated,
  observed,
  average_population
)

metric_labels <- c(
  cycle_mean = "Epidemic cycles (mean)",
  cycle_sd = "Epidemic cycles (s.d.)",
  reintroductions = "Number of reintroductions",
  zeros = "Number of zeros",
  duration_mean = "Epidemic durations (mean)",
  duration_sd = "Epidemic durations (s.d.)"
)

metric_order <- c(
  "cycle_mean", "cycle_sd", "reintroductions", "zeros",
  "duration_mean", "duration_sd"
)
```

```{r plot-figure-2, fig.width=11, fig.height=6.4}
####### plotting figure 2 directly in the report #######
layout(matrix(1:6, 2, 3, byrow = TRUE))
par(
  mar = c(3.5, 4.2, 1.1, 0.7),
  mgp = c(2.3, 0.7, 0),
  family = "sans",
  cex.axis = 0.9,
  cex.lab = 0.95
)

for (metric in metric_order) {
  d <- predictive[predictive$metric == metric, ]
  ylim <- range(c(0, d$upper, d$observed), na.rm = TRUE)
  plot(
    d$population_upper,
    d$observed,
    type = "n",
    xlab = "Average population level",
    ylab = metric_labels[[metric]],
    xlim = c(0, 90000),
    ylim = ylim,
    las = 1,
    xaxt = "n"
  )
  axis(
    1,
    at = c(0, 22500, 45000, 67500, 90000),
    labels = format(
      c(0, 22500, 45000, 67500, 90000),
      big.mark = ",",
      scientific = FALSE
    )
  )
  polygon(
    c(d$population_upper, rev(d$population_upper)),
    c(d$lower, rev(d$upper)),
    col = "#D0D2D4",
    border = NA
  )
  points(d$population_upper, d$observed, pch = 20, cex = 0.66)
  box()
}
```

# Figure 3: prevaccination source attribution

```{r calculate-figure-3}
####### calculating the figure 3 source attribution #######
attrib_3 <- source_attribution(
  pre,
  pre_small,
  seq_len(nrow(pre$cases)),
  pre_parameters,
  pre_parameters$tau
)

coords_3 <- attrib_3$coordinates
core <- c(
  "London", "Birmingham", "Liverpool", "Manchester", "Sheffield",
  "Leeds", "Newcastle", "Bristol", "Cardiff", "Swansea",
  "Plymouth", "Norwich", "Portsmouth"
)
core_colors <- c(
  London = "#F0E442",
  Birmingham = "#56B4E9",
  Liverpool = "#0072B2",
  Manchester = "#009E73",
  Sheffield = "#D55E00",
  Leeds = "#CC79A7",
  Newcastle = "#E69F00",
  Bristol = "#B2DF8A",
  Cardiff = "#F781BF",
  Swansea = "#E31A1C",
  Plymouth = "#FFB000",
  Norwich = "#984EA3",
  Portsmouth = "#A6CEE3"
)

attrib_3$city$category <- ifelse(
  attrib_3$city$dominant_source %in% core,
  attrib_3$city$dominant_source,
  "Other"
)
attrib_3$city$lisa <- local_moran_classes(
  attrib_3$city$background,
  coords_3
)

land_3 <- make_land_outline(pre$coordinates)
global_3 <- colMeans(
  attrib_3$event[, c("background", "gravity")],
  na.rm = TRUE
)
other_distance <- attrib_3$city$dominant_distance_km[
  attrib_3$city$category == "Other"
]
```

```{r plot-figure-3, fig.width=10.5, fig.height=8.2}
  density_3,

  xlim = c(0, 150),
  xlab = "Distance of spread (km)",
  ylab = "Density",
  main = "",
  las = 1
)
polygon(
  c(density_3$x, rev(density_3$x)),
  c(density_3$y, rep(0, length(density_3$y))),
  col = "#888888",
  border = "#333333"
)
panel_label("d")
```

# Figure 4: vaccination-era changes

```{r calculate-figure-4}
####### calculating the figure 4 risk classes and synchrony #######
periods <- data.frame(
  label = c(
    "1960-64", "1970-74", "1975-79",
    "1980-84", "1985-89", "1990-94"
  ),
  start = c(60, 70, 75, 80, 85, 90),
  end = c(65, 75, 80, 85, 90, 95),
  tau_file = c("tau", "tau_2", "tau_2", "tau_3", "tau_4", "tau_5")
)

period_results <- vector("list", nrow(periods))
synchrony_results <- vector("list", nrow(periods))
global_4 <- data.frame(
  period = periods$label,
  gravity = NA_real_,
  background = NA_real_
)

for (i in seq_len(nrow(periods))) {
  rows <- which(
    vac$time >= periods$start[i] & vac$time < periods$end[i]
  )
  tau_i <- posterior_median(vac_mcmc, periods$tau_file[i])
  attribution <- source_attribution(
    vac,
    vac_small,
    rows,
    vac_parameters,
    tau_i
  )
  attribution$city$period <- periods$label[i]
  attribution$city$dominant_class <- ifelse(
    attribution$city$gravity >= attribution$city$background,
    "Gravity",
    "Unidentifiable"
  )
  attribution$city$class_share <- pmax(
    attribution$city$gravity,
    attribution$city$background
  )
  period_results[[i]] <- attribution$city

  global_4$background[i] <- mean(
    attribution$city$dominant_class == "Unidentifiable",
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
  global_4$gravity[i] <- 1 - global_4$background[i]

  synchrony <- pairwise_synchrony(
    vac$cases[rows, , drop = FALSE],
    vac$coordinates
  )
  synchrony$period <- periods$label[i]
  synchrony_results[[i]] <- synchrony
}

city_4 <- do.call(rbind, period_results)
synchrony_4 <- do.call(rbind, synchrony_results)
coords_4 <- vac$coordinates[match(vac_small, vac$names), , drop = FALSE]
land_4 <- make_land_outline(vac$coordinates)

coverage <- c(0.00, 0.50, 0.50, 0.65, 0.84, 0.93)
line_colors <- c(
  "#222222", "#E41A1C", "#FB6A4A",
  "#CB181D", "#969696", "#525252"
)
line_types <- c(1, 3, 2, 4, 5, 6)
```

## Figure 4a: location-wise risk classification

```{r plot-figure-4a, fig.width=13, fig.height=5.2}
####### plotting figure 4a #######
par(mar = c(4, 4, 2.8, 0.8), family = "sans", mgp = c(2.4, 0.7, 0))
plot.new()
plot.window(xlim = c(0, 6), ylim = c(0, 1))

for (i in seq_len(6)) {
  d <- city_4[city_4$period == periods$label[i], ]
  x_offset <- i - 1
  x <- x_offset + (coords_4[, 1] + 6) / 8
  y <- (coords_4[, 2] - 50) / 6
  polygon(
    x_offset + (land_4[, 1] + 6) / 8,
    (land_4[, 2] - 50) / 6,
    col = "#F1F1F1",
    border = "#BDBDBD"
  )
  colors <- ifelse(
    d$dominant_class == "Gravity",
    "#72C5E8",
    "#111111"
  )
  points(
    x,
    y,
    pch = 21,
    bg = colors,
    col = colors,
    cex = 0.15 + 1.05 * d$class_share
  )
  rect(
    x_offset,
    1,
    x_offset + 1,
    1.08,
    col = "#D9D9D9",
    border = "#555555",
    xpd = NA
  )
  text(
    x_offset + 0.5,
    1.04,
    periods$label[i],
    cex = 0.8,
    xpd = NA
  )
}

axis(1, at = seq(0.5, 5.5, 1), labels = rep("", 6), tick = FALSE)
mtext("Longitude", 1, line = 2.2)
mtext("Latitude", 2, line = 2.2)
legend(
  "bottomleft",
  legend = c("Gravity", "Unidentifiable"),
  pch = 21,
  pt.bg = c("#72C5E8", "#111111"),
  bty = "n",
  horiz = TRUE,
  cex = 0.9
)
panel_label("a", y = 1.08)
```

# Validation

```{r validation}
####### validating the inline reconstruction #######
stopifnot(
  nrow(predictive) == 240,
  sum(is.finite(predictive$observed)) > 200,
  nrow(attrib_3$city) == 872,
  mean(attrib_3$event$gravity, na.rm = TRUE) > 0.85,
  nrow(global_4) == 6,
  all(abs(global_4$background + global_4$gravity - 1) < 1e-8),
  all(diff(global_4$background) >= -1e-8),
  global_4$background[1] < 0.05,
  global_4$background[6] > 0.90
)

cat("inline paper reconstruction validation passed")
```
